id: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998)

facts.text: Serve the mains when the lads plan the robbery over breakfast.
facts.why: Eddie overhears the neighbours planning the heist through the thin wall. No breakfast scene shows in the plot or transcript.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Eddie overhears the neighbours planning their robbery.

facts.text: We lost half a million at Harry's card table, lads, so tonight it's beans on toast. We've a week to find the rest.
facts.why: Not a line Eddie says. It is printed in quote marks as dialogue. The film has Eddie owing Harry 500,000 pounds with one week to pay, but no 'beans on toast' speech.
facts.fix: The entire British Empire was built on cups of tea.

fix_note.text: The entire British Empire was built on cups of tea.

facts.why: The debt is 500,000 pounds, not dollars. The film is set in London.
facts.applied_note: The saloon layout always printed a dollar sign. It now takes a per-film currency from data/film-flavour.json, set to £ for this film.

facts.why: No greasy spoon cafe appears in the plot or transcript, so the note claims a place the film does not show.
facts.fix: A fry up, brown sauce on the side.

facts.text: Soap's the cook, but he'd still serve this.
facts.why: The transcript has Soap fussing over his soup and the gang's chef costume line, and the narration says he is proud of his legal job.

vibe.verdict: Good British pub food and the tea quote, hatchet and IOU, but the wild west lettering does not suit a London crime film.
